title: Finding — Emotion per model (WESAD · EEVR · CASE circumplex + timeline)

options.content:
**The same emotion circumplex + timeline, computed separately for each of the 3 valence models, on YOUR live signal.** Each row = one model.

- **X (valence)** = that model's `valence_personal_60s` — personally calibrated on the SERVER (neutral = your own measured resting median, per model) and 60 s-smoothed, exactly like the original WESAD circumplex. Shown only after that model's baseline locks (`valence_baseline_ready`).
- **Y (arousal)** = the same real arousal `z_filtered` for all three (arousal is shared, only valence differs between models).
- **Quadrant**: NW fear/anger · NE happy/excited · SW sad/bored · SE calm/relaxed. Neutral dead-band = that model's own `valence_deadband`.

**WESAD** ≈ arousal-in-disguise (82%, but SHAP says it's HR) · **EEVR** ≈ chance (56%) · **CASE** ≈ real offline (58%) but COLLAPSES on the watch (domain shift — outputs a near-constant, so it sits at its own neutral). Watch how the SAME instant lands in DIFFERENT quadrants per model — that disagreement is the thesis point.

targets.rawSql: SELECT x, y_ring, y_state FROM (SELECT 1.5*sin(g*0.0785398) AS x, 1.5*cos(g*0.0785398) AS y_ring, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS y_state FROM generate_series(0,80) AS t(g) UNION ALL SELECT GREATEST(-1.5, LEAST(1.5, v.valence_personal_60s)) AS x, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS y_ring, GREATEST(-1.5, LEAST(1.5, CAST(l.z_filtered AS DOUBLE))) AS y_state FROM biofizic_live l JOIN biofizic_legacy_valence_wesad v ON l.time = v.time WHERE l.z_filtered IS NOT NULL AND v.valence_personal_60s IS NOT NULL AND v.valence_baseline_ready >= 0.5 AND $__timeFilter(l.time)) u ORDER BY x

SELECT l.time, CASE WHEN v.valence_baseline_ready < 0.5 THEN 0 WHEN abs(v.valence_personal_60s) < v.valence_deadband THEN 0 WHEN l.z_filtered >= 0 AND v.valence_personal_60s >= 0 THEN 3 WHEN l.z_filtered >= 0 THEN 4 WHEN v.valence_personal_60s >= 0 THEN 1 ELSE 2 END AS emotion FROM biofizic_live l JOIN biofizic_legacy_valence_wesad v ON l.time = v.time WHERE l.z_filtered IS NOT NULL AND v.valence_personal_60s IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(l.time) ORDER BY l.time
